appearanceDetail: Choose the theme used on this device.
languageDetail: Choose the language used in Patternly.
languageIntro: Choose the language used on this device.
languageSystemDetail: Follow your device language when Patternly supports it.
languageSystemUnrecognizedDetail: Your device language could not be recognized. System will use English temporarily.
accountDetail: Manage sync, recovery, deletion, and sign out.
guestAccountDetail: Your progress stays on this device. Sign in or create an account to sync and restore it.
signedOutAccount: Sign in or create an account
signedOutAccountDetail: Sign in to sync and restore your progress.
accountAttentionDetail: Review sync status, retry, or sign out safely.
verificationPendingDetail: Check your email to finish signing in.
guestAccessBlocked: Sign in to use saved progress
guestAccessBlockedDetail: This saved progress belongs to another account. Sign in to continue.
accountOfflineDetail: Your saved learning is available here. Reconnect to sync changes and use account services.
accountBusyDetail: An account operation is in progress.
signOutDetail: Safely sync pending changes before signing out.
dataDetail: Manage your data and view privacy options.
backendDiagnosticsDetail: Run every local backend path on this simulator.
premiumTestingDetail: Simulate Premium entitlement on this test device.
goalDetail: Set your learning goal and preferred practice days.
securityOptionUnavailableDescription: This screen is no longer available. Return to settings and choose an available account option.
emailDetail: Update the email used for your account.
passwordDetail: Manage how you protect your account.
emailChangeAddressError: Enter a valid new email address, different from your current one.
emailChangeAddressUnavailable: This email address can't be used. Try a different address.
emailChangePasswordError: We couldn't verify your password. Check it and try again.
emailChangeIntro: Verify your identity to send a confirmation link to the new address. Your current email stays unchanged until you confirm that link.
passwordChangeIntro: Confirm your current password and choose a new one with at least 8 characters. After your password changes, you will need to sign in again on your other devices.
exportAuthenticationIntro: Confirm your identity, return to the data screen, and choose the download action again.
exportAuthenticationFailed: Your sign-in provider could not confirm your identity. Try again.
privacyAuthenticationIntro: Confirm your identity, return to privacy requests, and retry the action.
providerPassword: You sign in with Google or Apple. Manage your password with that provider; this account has no Patternly password.
emailChangePendingWaiting: Open the link in that message, then return to Patternly. The screen updates automatically.
emailChangePendingConfirmed: Your new email is confirmed and matches your account.
emailChangePendingRefreshError: Reconnect, then leave and return to Patternly to check the confirmation again.
emailChangePendingUnavailable: This request belongs to another session. Return to Settings and start the change again.
passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Sign in again on your other devices.
deleteConsequences: Your sign-in, account progress, and learning data on this device will be deleted. Device preferences and limited security records will remain.
deletePendingSync: Sync pending changes before deleting your account.
holdDeleteHint: Hold for at least 3 seconds, then release. Releasing early cancels deletion.
premiumEntryDetail: View the monthly plan, restore purchases, or manage your subscription.
premiumRenewalSummary: No trial. Renews automatically each month at the storefront price until cancelled.
premiumAccountRequiredDetail: Premium is available to users aged 18 or over with a Patternly account. Guest learning remains available.
premiumOfflineAccountRequiredDetail: Your account is available for local learning on this device. Reconnect and refresh your account to check Premium access before buying, restoring, or managing a subscription.
premiumLoadingDetail: We are checking the current price for your storefront.
premiumUnavailableDetail: New purchases are currently unavailable. Existing subscribers can still restore purchases and manage their subscription.
premiumLoadFailedDetail: Check your connection and try again later.
premiumPaymentDetail: Apple charges your App Store account when you confirm the purchase.
premiumCancellationDetail: Cancel in your App Store subscription settings before renewal. Deleting your Patternly account does not cancel the subscription.
premiumWithdrawalDetail: For the ongoing digital service, withdrawal may involve a proportional charge for service supplied at your request before withdrawal.
premiumInstantStartConsent: I expressly request that Premium starts immediately after purchase and acknowledge that a proportional charge may apply if I withdraw after service has started.
premiumPausedDetail: Premium is unavailable while this subscription is paused. Resume it in the store where it was purchased.
premiumOnHoldDetail: The store has placed this subscription on hold. Resolve the payment in the store where it was purchased.
premiumSuccessDetail: Patternly Premium access was confirmed by the server.
premiumVerificationDeniedDetail: The server did not confirm active Premium. Check the subscription in the store where you purchased it or restore purchases.
premiumCancelledDetail: The store operation was cancelled. No Premium access was granted by this operation.
premiumActionFailedDetail: The request failed. Check your connection and store account. Use Refresh status to verify any purchase outcome before trying to buy again.
premiumCheckingDetail: We are checking your subscription. A new purchase is blocked until the result is known.
premiumPaymentPendingDetail: Follow the store instructions to complete or approve this payment. Premium is not confirmed yet. Do not buy again; access will be checked when you return.
premiumUnknownDetail: The purchase outcome is not confirmed. Do not buy again. Refresh the status or manage the subscription in the store where you purchased it; contact support if it remains unresolved.
premiumReceiptIssueDetail: Your purchase confirmation needs review. This does not confirm an email receipt. Contact support; do not purchase again to resolve it.
premiumManageUnavailableDetail: No management link was returned. Open subscriptions in the store account where you purchased Premium.
premiumTermsRequiredDetail: Read the current Terms and complete account acceptance before a new purchase. Restore and subscription management remain available.
premiumNotStartedDetail: The store purchase was not launched. The saved request needs resolution before another purchase. Refresh its status or contact support.
premiumScopeUnavailableDetail: The service description is not confirmed yet. New purchases are unavailable; you can still restore purchases and manage an existing subscription.
premiumServiceScopeSummary: The first nodes in each learning track are free. Premium unlocks the remaining nodes.
preferencesUnavailableDetail: Saved preferences could not be read. Choices are disabled until local storage is available.
